[[File:Icon-vehicle.png|40px]]

A '''Vehicle''' is a [[Star Wars CCG]] card type that deploys to a site. Premiere subtypes are [[Transport]] and [[Creature Vehicle]]. Do not confuse this with [[Vehicle Weapon]].

Premiere examples: [[Luke's X-34 Landspeeder]], [[Lift Tube]], [[Sandcrawler]], [[Bantha]].
